rawContent: Traffic stops should not end in death, period. Racism has long been a public health threat to Black and brown Americans — our leaders must take action to stop it before more lives are lost. #BlackLivesMatter

Daunte Wright should be alive today. My heart goes out to his loved ones in the aftermath of this tragedy. Too many Black lives have been taken by our broken criminal justice system: we need accountability, justice, and urgent action to save lives from this same fate. #BLM
